correctness.rationale: Theorem 5.7/5.9 of Araújo et al classifies admissible pairs of partial bijections alpha:I->Iprime and partition-block bijections beta, with special k<=1 quotient. For k>=2 choose binom(n,k)^2 k! partial alpha; choose marked source partition R on k points with q blocks in S(k,q) ways; extend each source/target marked partition with t extra unmarked blocks by U_m(q,t) each, and permute these t free blocks t! ways. Subtract B_k m! cases all m unmarked points are singleton blocks, forbidden by Theorem 5.9, then add the exactly n! full-domain units. For m=1, sum_q q^2 S(k,q)=B_(k+2)-2B_(k+1). Independently computed exact all-rank formula n=2..6 and an unrelated pair-of-partitions enumeration n<=4 (orders 7,106,5825). The structural theorem itself is a published input, not independently reproved for unbounded n.
